en: A black‑and‑white, elevated view over a small European town with dense rows of 2–4‑story gabled houses and shops lining a cobblestone street. The foreground shows tiled rooftops; in the mid‑ground, several commercial buildings display German signage at street level. Beyond the town center are trees, factory chimneys, and open countryside. The architecture suggests late 19th‑ to early 20th‑century Central Europe.
